nodes.label: Target-space mapping
nodes.runbook: Use workgraph-arc-planning. Map the related backlog/target space before scope fencing. Classify primary spine candidates, supporting items, adjacent/deferred items, dependencies, blockers, and anti-scope. Do not choose final scope yet.

evidenceRequirements.description: Related backlog target-space map for planning arc.

nodes.label: Value / learning / unlock triage
nodes.runbook: Use the target-space map to rank candidate clusters by banked durable value, staked learning, bootstrap capital, downstream unlock, recurring friction removed, risk retired, effort/complexity, sequencing leverage, and scope containment. Recommend candidate spines for scope fencing. Do not implement.

evidenceRequirements.description: Value/learning/unlock triage and ranked candidate clusters.

nodes.label: Scope fence
nodes.runbook: Create the planning scope fence after mapping and value triage. Define recommended primary candidate scope for deeper design, supporting items, deferred items, anti-scope, and open questions. Mark each linked Bug/Idea with scopeRole: fully-in-scope, partial, deferred, or related-only. Keep implementation arc bounded while maximizing learning/capital/unlock.

evidenceRequirements.description: Scope fence for implementation arc design phase.

nodes.label: Engineer current-state inventory
nodes.runbook: Use workgraph-arc-participant. Inventory current implementation surfaces relevant to the selected candidate scope. Facts only; no design.

evidenceRequirements.description: Engineer current-state inventory for selected candidate scope.

nodes.label: Verifier failure-mode audit
nodes.runbook: Use workgraph-arc-participant. Audit failure modes for selected candidate scope. Identify proof needed, gates, scope-creep risks, closeout verification requirements, acceptance criteria, and red lines. Do not implement.

evidenceRequirements.description: Verifier failure-mode audit for selected candidate scope.

nodes.label: Architect design options
nodes.runbook: Synthesize design options using scope fence, inventory, and verifier audit. Compare candidate arc shapes and sequencing. Include rejected alternatives and anti-scope. Do not implement.

evidenceRequirements.description: Architect design options packet for implementation arc.

nodes.label: Engineer feasibility sketch
nodes.runbook: Use workgraph-arc-participant. Review architect design options for implementation feasibility. Identify files/surfaces, small vs large cuts, operational risk, sequencing, and whether scope remains bounded. Do not implement.

evidenceRequirements.description: Engineer feasibility sketch for design options.

nodes.label: Verifier design gate
nodes.runbook: Use workgraph-arc-participant. Gate the design before implementation. Verify that the proposed arc has concrete artifacts, encoded dependencies, validation including structural/negative checks, closeout and survey proof requirements, active-surface truth boundaries, explicit anti-scope, and entityRealizationPlan/disposition gates for every fully-in-scope Bug/Idea. Pass or fail with required repairs.

evidenceRequirements.description: Verifier design gate report for implementation arc readiness.

nodes.label: Final design packet
nodes.runbook: Write the final implementation-arc design packet after the design gate. Include selected arc spine, supporting/deferred items, acceptance criteria, verifier gates, anti-scope, implementation blueprint outline, entityRealizationPlan for every fully-in-scope Bug/Idea, disposition gates, allowed non-closure conditions, and lessons for planning methodology.

evidenceRequirements.description: Final design packet for selected implementation arc.

nodes.label: Planning closeout
nodes.runbook: Use workgraph-arc-closeout. Close the planning arc with WorkGraph state, selected implementation arc, rejected alternatives, anti-scope, live walkthrough status, friction assessment, entity disposition, residuals, final non-claims, and an entityDispositionLedger covering every fully-in-scope Bug/Idea as closed/incorporated, accepted-deferred, blocked, reclassified, or explicitly non-claimed. Complete before the driver.

nodes.label: Planning arc driver
nodes.runbook: Use workgraph-arc-operator. Controller driver for a planning/design WorkGraph. Do not implement the selected arc. Complete last only after every planning child and closeout is done.

evidenceRequirements.description: Planning closeout packet including final design, target selection rationale, friction assessment, and lessons.
